groups.instructions: Complete the form below. Write ONE WORD AND/OR A NUMBER for each answer.

questions.explanation: He first mentions the eighth, then changes to 'the sixth of September'.
Course is twelve weeks but he wants 'ten weeks with the family'.
'I don't eat meat, but I do eat fish.'
'I'm allergic to cats.' Dogs are fine.
'one hundred and sixty-five pounds a week'.

questions.prompt: Preference: within ________ distance of the school
Family details sent by email within ________ working days
Will be met at the ________ station

groups.strategy: Listen for changes of mind ('I was going to say… but actually…'). Numbers often appear twice — the second one is usually the answer.
